_doc: T3745 disk budget (rule 36 hard limits, owner-tunable). docs/t3745-disk-safety.md. Every big writer calls tools.datadisk.check before it starts; the capture runtime enforces the capture_* values itself.

profiles._doc: T3740: TSFP_DISK_PROFILE=<name> overrides the keys above. remote_worker (set by tools.wt.remote_replay on replay workers): the root only must not fill (3 GB); data_min_free_gb is the worker's disk_floor_gb in tools/data/remote_hosts.json (TSFP_DISK_HOST names it), checked on the data volume the capture writes to. The owner-PC floors (100 GB root, 60 GB data) refused every remote capture.
